description.zh: 基于德波诺「六顶思考帽」的决策推演工作台。蓝帽编排，白绿黄黑红五帽递进审议，最后由蓝帽收束决策报告。全程串行、本地留档、可导出 Markdown。
description.en: Decision workbench based on Six Thinking Hats. Deliberate across facts, ideas, value, risks, and intuition, synthesized into a final decision report.

releaseNotes.zh: 修正英文描述超长导致 manifest 无法加载的问题（官方上限 200 字符）；同步强化打包与体检工具的规范校验。
releaseNotes.en: Fixed the English description exceeding the 200-character manifest limit that blocked loading. Hardened the packaging and validation tooling.
